# Tavaro Group

> Tavaro is a hospitality and lifestyle group in Hyderabad, India, creating places for people to stay, live, gather and grow. It has five brands: Tavaro Resorts (a 16-acre resort and wedding venue in Kokapet), Tavaro Residences, Tavaro Experiences, Wellness at Tavaro and Màre Coffee House.

Contact for every brand: phone and WhatsApp +91 998 998 3029, email celebrate@tavaro.in. Location: Kokapet, West Hyderabad, Telangana, India. Prices below are indicative; live rates and availability come from the team.

## Tavaro Resorts, Kokapet, Hyderabad

- [Tavaro Resorts](https://resort.tavaro.in/): a 16-acre resort in Kokapet with 13 rooms (6 suites, 7 executive rooms), six event venues for 50 to 4,000 guests, Tavaro Dining, Màre Coffee House, Sol Pilates Studio, a 40 ft pool with a baby pool, and parking for up to 1,500 cars.
- [Wedding and event venues](https://resort.tavaro.in/venues): capacities, catering and how to book a site visit.
  - Tavaro Lawn: outdoor lawn, 60,000 sq ft, 2,500 seated / 4,000 standing. Weddings and receptions.
  - Sanctuary Lawn: outdoor lawn, 24,000 sq ft, 500 seated / 600 standing. Mehendi, sangeet and engagements.
  - Sanctuary Hall: air-conditioned indoor hall, 4,000 sq ft, 250 seated / 350 standing.
  - Pool & Pool Deck: 15,000 sq ft, 100 seated / 150 standing. Haldi mornings and poolside evenings.
  - Tavaro House & Backyard: heritage villa, 50 seated / 100 standing. Rituals, family lunches and photos; the couple can stay here.
  - Tree Deck: outdoor deck around a 250-year-old tree, 12,000 sq ft, 120 seated / 200 standing.
  - In-house catering from ₹2,500 per plate (taxes extra), with live kitchens. Outside caterers and your own décor vendors are welcome. Venue prices on request.
- [Rooms and suites](https://resort.tavaro.in/accommodations): Executive Room (320 sq ft, 2 adults, bed and breakfast, about ₹18,500 a night); Suite (480 sq ft, 2 adults, bed and breakfast, about ₹32,000 a night); Tavaro House (2,800 sq ft, four bedrooms, 8 adults, about ₹95,000 a night, only with Tavaro Lawn bookings).
- [Location and directions](https://resort.tavaro.in/location): about 15 minutes from Gachibowli, 30 minutes from Jubilee Hills Checkpost and 35 minutes from Rajiv Gandhi International Airport.
- [Things to do](https://resort.tavaro.in/things-to-do/explore) and [private celebrations and experiences](https://resort.tavaro.in/things-to-do/create).
- [Photos and videos](https://resort.tavaro.in/photos): weddings, sangeet, haldi and mehendi, corporate offsites, food and décor at the resort.

## Màre Coffee House

- [Màre Coffee House](https://mare.tavaro.in/): Tavaro's coffee house at Tavaro Resorts, Kokapet, open to guests and the wider community. Specialty coffee and single-origin pour overs, a bakery baked daily, all-day breakfast, light plates and a seasonal drinks menu.

## Tavaro Residences

- [Tavaro Residences](https://residences.tavaro.in/): homes in West Hyderabad, designed around greenery, light and calm.
- [Leela](https://residences.tavaro.in/leela): apartments of about 3,027 sq ft (super built-up) with planted terraces and a shared rooftop lounge, yoga deck and gazebo, about 15 minutes west of Hyderabad's Financial District. Brochure and floor plans on the page.
- [Bhairavi Nilayam](https://residences.tavaro.in/bhairavi-nilayam): a 15,000 sq ft private residence by Praveen Architects on the outskirts of West Hyderabad, with three floors, five bedrooms, about 7,000 sq ft of garden and lawn, Vastu-conscious planning, an office block and a terrace gym.

## Tavaro Experiences

- [Tavaro Experiences](https://experiences.tavaro.in/): curated social and cultural gatherings, culinary evenings, wellness retreats and corporate offsites at Tavaro Resorts and Màre. Upcoming and past events are listed on the page, each with its own booking page.
- The Offsite Edit: corporate offsites and team days, leadership retreats, brand activations and after-hours dining, shaped around the client's brief.

## Wellness at Tavaro

- [Wellness at Tavaro](https://wellness.tavaro.in/): wellness as a way of living across Tavaro, in three pillars: physical wellness (Pilates, yoga, fitness), mental wellness (meditation, breathwork) and restorative living (sleep, food, nature).
- Sol Pilates Studio at Tavaro Resorts: Pilates, reformer sessions, mobility and guided fitness.
- Leaf by Tavaro, Mahalingapuram: a restorative retreat, coming soon.

## About and contact
